risks.risk: Wrong fitment for the buyer’s car (different model/year/trim) even if the shape looks similar.
risks.proof: A photo of the headlight back label/part number (or the exact car make/model/year it fits) plus a photo showing the mounting points.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic used headlight pair with uncertain fitment (worst-case: may not fit).

risks.risk: Not working or weak output (bulbs/LEDs, ballasts, or internal wiring may be faulty).
risks.proof: A short video showing both headlights switched ON in a dark area, with beam pattern visible.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not guaranteed working (worst-case: needs repair/replace).

risks.risk: Missing parts or damaged connectors/mounting tabs not visible from the current angles.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the back side connectors, wiring entry, and all mounting tabs/holes.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as complete but with potential missing/damaged mounting parts (worst-case: may require parts).

risks.risk: Originality/quality uncertainty (could be aftermarket or refurbished).
risks.proof: Photo of any OEM/brand stamp and the part number on the housing lens/back.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as used/possibly aftermarket with no confirmed OEM status.

proof_requests: Send a clear photo of the part number/OEM marking on the back of each headlight (label/stamp).
Send a video showing both headlights ON (left and right) with beam pattern in a dark setting.
Send close-ups of the back connectors and all mounting tabs/holes to confirm completeness and fitment.
response.reason: From photo 0 the headlights look clean, but there’s no readable part number and no proof they work or fit the buyer’s exact car. The missing fitment and functionality proof prevents a confident worst-case price.
